request.description: Returns full contact details of an accepted lead. Each reveal is written to the lead timeline and the audit log with the firm and assignment, and moves the assignment to `working`. Refused before acceptance (409) or when sharing consent is gone (403). Partner context. The firm owner sees every lead offered to the firm; a firm member (agent) sees only leads the owner handed to them. Lead protection: before acceptance the name is shortened (e.g. `Ramesh K.`) and the business name and notes are hidden; contact details stay masked until revealed, and every reveal is logged.
